name: Theobald
description: A goblin helper of the wizard Malfegor who oversees the Goblin Balloon Brigade.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Goblin Balloon Brigade sets out, pulls Roxanne aloft, and crashes toward enemy troops.
timeline.quote: However, Roxanne gets tangled in the rope as they lift off and is pulled up into the air along with the balloon.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Airborne All the Way! , by David Drake". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
